metadata.title: Retail Sales Unexpectedly Fell by 0.6% in July<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Retail Sales Unexpectedly Fell by 0.6% in July
Sales at U.S. retailers last month proved much weaker than expected. But the surprising slump may be due more to one-time factors than a strong signal that consumer spending is substantially weakening.
